title: Fix re-sign-in actor/session scoping and React Query cache invalidation for events/tasks

requirements.summary: Ensure the backend actor is recreated/refetched on any Internet Identity session change (even same principal) so access-control initialization reruns and events/tasks no longer fail after re-sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: Using the reproduction steps (sign in → create an event + task → save → lock → sign out → sign back in → unlock), the app loads events and tasks successfully without showing “Failed to load events” or “Failed to load tasks”.

After signing back in, the frontend must not reuse an actor instance initialized with a previous identity session; the actor must be re-created or re-initialized for the new identity session before events/tasks queries run.
No manual page refresh is required to make events/tasks load after re-sign-in.

file_operations.description: Update the actor React Query cache key to include a per-auth-session fingerprint (not just principal) so a new actor is created after re-login even when the principal is unchanged; adjust refetch behavior so `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(...)` reliably runs for the new session and dependent queries only refetch once the new actor is ready. Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance for clearing cached application data on logout/session changes; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the app shell and calendar views only render once the updated actor/session prerequisites are satisfied (authenticated + profile + unlocked), preventing events/tasks queries from running against a stale actor during re-sign-in transitions. Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance (logged-in required before showing application data); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Scope calendar React Query caches to the currently authenticated principal/session and ensure clean refetch after re-authentication and unlock.
acceptanceCriteria: Signing out and signing back in does not leave EventsView/TasksView stuck in an error state due to previously cached query errors.
Events and tasks data shown always corresponds to the currently signed-in principal.
After unlocking the encryption session post-login, events/tasks automatically load without requiring the user to press Retry.

file_operations.description: Adjust events/tasks query keys to include the current principal (and, if available from the actor/auth layer, the same session fingerprint used for the actor) so cached data/errors cannot leak across sign-out/sign-in; update query options to refetch cleanly when the actor becomes ready and when the encryption session transitions to unlocked (e.g., refetch-on-mount and avoiding reuse of cached error states).

Remove reliance on manual page refresh to recover from auth/session transitions by ensuring the view’s error/loading UX aligns with the updated query behavior (automatic refetch after session+unlock readiness), while keeping UI composition limited to existing shadcn/ui components (read-only under frontend/src/components/ui).

Align tasks view error/loading UX with the updated principal/session-scoped query keys and refetch behavior so the view recovers automatically after re-login + unlock without requiring Retry or Refresh Page, composing (not editing) shadcn/ui components.

On logout, clear all cached application data and ensure any user-scoped in-memory state is reset so the next sign-in starts from a clean cache (per authorization component guidance); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix encryption unlock state handling to use proper Zustand updates and ensure lock/unlock transitions don’t block calendar queries once actor + key prerequisites are met.
acceptanceCriteria: Unlocking updates the UI state consistently (no stuck loading/spinner states), including after a sign-out/sign-in cycle.
After unlocking, events/tasks queries become enabled and execute successfully when the actor is ready.

file_operations.description: Replace direct Zustand store mutation for `isUnlocking` with proper Zustand state updates; ensure lock/unlock transitions are consistent and reset appropriately on identity changes (e.g., logout or principal change) so the UI cannot remain in a stale unlocking/loading state and queries can enable when actor + key are satisfied.

Ensure the unlock modal reflects the corrected `isUnlocking` Zustand state (button disabling and label updates) so it cannot get stuck during re-sign-in flows and unlock reliably triggers the app to proceed to the shell where queries run.

Ensure lock/logout actions reset encryption state predictably (lock clears key; logout clears key + cached queries) so subsequent re-login and unlock transitions always allow calendar queries to run when ready, while composing (not editing) shadcn/ui components.
